title: Walking through the Wizard City starting area's doors: the Commons to Ravenwood and back, into the Headmistress House and out, and an edited door after .reload zone_teleport
notes: 6.14: the game master is put just before a door facing it, at the arrival point of the door that leads back, turned a half turn, and walks forward.
The server logs the door it walked through and where zone_teleport sends it; a door to another zone shows the loading screen and the wizard
attaches again there. The Commons' Ravenwood gate is behind quest requirements, so Zone.DoorsIgnoreRequirements is set for this run;
the Headmistress House entrance has none. Updates.AllowPending applies the pending zone_teleport SQL while this milestone is open.
Last, the house entrance's row is changed in the world database and .reload zone_teleport sends the next walk-through to the new place.
server_log_allowed: character_create_school holds no school, so no wizard can be created until it does
realmlist holds no realm, so no player can be sent to a gameserver until one is added
zone_teleport was not reloaded and generation 0 goes on serving: WizardCity/WC_Hub trigger 'Lost door' leads to Nowhere/NoSuchZone, which the zones do not hold
